diagram_candidates.certainty: editorial candidate; source gives a complete parameterized union and names the corner parameter
diagram_candidates.excerpt: The capacity region is the union over 0≤ρ≤1 of the nonnegative rate pairs satisfying the two individual-rate bounds and the sum-rate bound.
diagram_candidates.maps_and_check: In the (R_1,R_2) plane, depict the fixed-ρ constraints R_j≤(1/2)ln(1+P_j(1−ρ²)/N) and R_1+R_2≤(1/2)ln(1+(P_1+P_2+2ρ√(P_1P_2))/N); show their union as ρ varies over [0,1], mark the ρ_* sum-corner identified by the source, and label axes in nats/use. Keep the parameters symbolic or state any chosen illustrative values.
diagram_candidates.reason: The parameter trades individual-rate limits against the sum-rate limit; a plot can expose this movement and distinguish it from the no-feedback region.
